## Open Validation submission

Track: REPRODUCE / CHALLENGE / VALIDATE

### Exact target
- Artifact/protocol:
- SHA-256 or immutable ref:
- Claim/section/test:

### What changed
Describe every deviation from the frozen target. State whether any locked outcome was inspected before the change.

### Result
- Verdict: PASS / FAIL / PARTIAL / INCONCLUSIVE / OUT_OF_SCOPE
- Evidence level: 0–8
- Matched baseline outcome: NOT_TESTED / TRIAID_WINS / BASELINE_WINS / MIXED / TIE / NOT_APPLICABLE
- Suggested claim impact: NO_CHANGE / SUPPORTS_WITHIN_SCOPE / NARROWS_CLAIM / FALSIFIES_COMPONENT / REQUIRES_CORRECTION / NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE

### Reproducibility
Provide exact commands, environment, data provenance, hashes, and result artifacts.

### Negative/null results
List them explicitly. Do not omit relevant failures.

### Declarations
- [ ] I did not relabel a post-outcome redesign as confirmatory.
- [ ] I did not weaken a comparator merely to improve TRIAID's relative result.
- [ ] I am not submitting private, identifying, or unauthorized data.
- [ ] My evidence-level language does not exceed the design.
